A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.12;

a city in Dan; probably the same as 'Beth-shemesh'
Another spelling of bet she.mesh (בֵּית שֶׁ֫מֶשׁ "Beth-shemesh" H1053)
